note.zh: 更多能量增长留在地面，太空仍以服务地球为主；K 上升不要求大规模太空扩张。
note.en: Most energy growth stays on Earth; space primarily serves Earth. Rising K need not imply large-scale space expansion.

note.zh: 通信、感知、算力、能源与物流逐步解耦，大型可维护平台与小卫星并存。
note.en: Communications, sensing, compute, power and logistics decouple; large maintainable platforms coexist with small satellites.

note.zh: 太空制造和本地资源更强，条件性纳入轨道环与地日能源群，不代表确定路线。
note.en: Stronger off-world manufacturing and resources; orbital rings and heliocentric energy arrays appear conditionally, not inevitably.

note.zh: 包括近地、地月、地日运行设施；当前参照仅为已知活跃载荷质量，不含所有空间物体。
note.en: Operating near-Earth, cislunar and heliocentric facilities; current reference is known active payload mass, not all space objects.

note.zh: 情景年度质量流，不从 2026 年内累计直接年化；后期不含太空本地制造。
note.en: Scenario annual mass flow, not an annualization of 2026 YTD; excludes later off-world manufacturing.

note.zh: 后期节点包含大型平台与物流设施，不等同于单颗卫星；不外推品牌申报数量。
note.en: Later nodes include large platforms and logistics facilities, not just satellites; no brand filing extrapolation.

note.zh: 示例大型模块，非全体卫星平均值；小卫星仍可长期存在。
note.en: Illustrative large module, not fleet-wide mean satellite mass; small satellites may persist.

note.zh: 全部为情景假设；扣除转换损失的可用功率，不能与文明总功率直接相加。
note.en: All values are assumptions; usable power after conversion losses, not additive to civilization-wide power.

note.zh: 驻留设计情景，不是人口或商业需求预测。
note.en: Residence design scenario, not a demographic or demand forecast.

role.zh: 服务、维修与拼装的技术边界；不提供本页数量预测。
role.en: Technology boundaries for service, repair and assembly; no numerical forecasts for this page.

role.zh: 能源系统的成本与能力缺口，不证明商业可行性。
role.en: Cost and capability gaps in space power, not proof of commercial viability.

role.zh: 公里级结构的概念研究，不是施工计划。
role.en: Concept study of kilometer-scale structures, not a construction plan.

role.zh: 月面物流的概念参照，不绑定预测年代。
role.en: Concept reference for lunar logistics, with no forecast date attached.
